info.desc: Go (1976) is the first album by Stomu Yamashta's fusion supergroup Go. Track listing: ("Winner/Loser" by Winwood, all other songs by Yamash'ta with lyrics by Quartermain) "Solitude" - 2:57 "Nature" - 2:32 "Air Over" - 2:32 "Crossing the Line" - 4:46 "Man of Leo" - 2:02 "Stellar" - 2:53 "Ghost Machine" - 2:06 "Surfspin" - 2:25 "Time is Here" - 2:46 "Space Theme" - 3:12 "Space Requiem" - 3:20 "Space Song" - 2:00 "Carnival" - 2:46 "Winner/Loser"- 4:10 A portion of 'Crossing The Line' appears on the soundtrack of Tempest (1982). .
